summary: Wide dirt verge beside bush, near the expressway, homes over 30 m away.
reasons: Wide bare verge off the lane

best_section.where: West verge of Market Street North, beside the bush before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the west side; nearest mapped homes 32 m and 45 m away at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt and grass verge about a lane wide meets the road edge; a van can pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Expressway runs close by to the south-east; the street itself looks quiet.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen and no signs; verge looks informally usable.

flags: Low-lying: about 4.7 m elevation, mapped waterway 5 m away
Guard posts at the south end of the verge
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the west, open to morning sun over the road.
